questions.questionText: Which statement best explains scarcity and opportunity cost?

options.text: It concerns the allocation and use of scarce resources under stated constraints

questions.explanation: The first option captures the economic resource-allocation perspective.

questions.questionText: A price rises from $12 to $14.40. Which concept would be most relevant when assessing the resulting change in quantity demanded?
questions.explanation: Price elasticity measures responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in price.

questions.questionText: A government introduces a policy related to elasticity. Evaluate one possible benefit and one possible drawback.

options.text: Benefits and costs depend on objectives, incentives, distributional effects and unintended consequences
Policy effects are independent of economic conditions

questions.explanation: Economic evaluation should consider both intended and unintended effects.
